headline: US Housing Market Strain and Everyday Inflation Influenced Midterm Results
summary: Persistent inflation across consumer goods and housing affordability hurdles were central issues for voters in the US midterm elections, contributing to the shift in congressional power.
why: Residential housing activity represents a major component of US gross domestic product and consumer sentiment.

impacts.name: US Housing Sector
impacts.why: Elevated mortgage rates and home price inflation constrained residential transaction volumes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
